Native Adventure action chooser source grammar, DF 53.16

Sources: native-owners.tsv, native-literals.tsv, native-calls.tsv,
steam-captions.asm, classic-captions.asm, and text-productions.tsv. The 77 primary vtables per
edition were rediscovered through MSVC RTTI class-hierarchy arrays containing
adventure_optionst. None of these files is a runtime observation or a test.
The text below is a manual semantic reconstruction of the native instructions.
RVAs below are Steam; native-owners.tsv provides the actual classic mapping by
class and slot. Steam PE:6a70a6d9:02711000; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000.

NOTATION AND DYNAMIC SOURCES
Quoted strings are native finite prose. Brackets are conditional clauses;
vertical bars select alternatives. Dynamic fields are retained as whole names,
not an enumeration of all generated worlds and modded RAW vocabulary.

DIR := NW | SW | West | NE | SE | East | North | South, optionally /Below or
       /Above; or pure Below | Above | Here. Exactly 27 native helper outputs.
       Steam helper 0x74f220; classic helper 0x74cc40.
LOC := " (" DIR ")"; sentinel origin x=-30000 suppresses the whole group.
       Get/Pick/Pull also suppress LOC when source and player x/y/z coincide.
MEDIA := ["/Air"] ["/Water"] ["/Lava" | "/Magma"]. These are separate native
         gates in that fixed order, not mutually exclusive choices. Air uses
         tile type plus each liquid depth <=6; Water/Magma gates are >0.
         Steam 0x8417ba..0x8418bc; the climbing/holding bodies repeat the gates.
MOVE_LOC := " (" DIR MEDIA ")".
CLIMB_LOC := " (" DIR (" holding " DIR | " releasing hold") MEDIA ")".
HOLD_LOC := " (" DIR [" from " DIR] MEDIA ")".
The directions after holding/from are calls to 0x74f220, not terrain names.
Entire MOVE_LOC/CLIMB_LOC/HOLD_LOC groups disappear at the origin sentinel;
media and holding/from cannot survive that omitted group.

ITEM := complete item designation, Steam helper 0xc65450. Includes quality,
        wear, subtype, material, creature/plant/raw noun, decorations and names.
        Captions request their actual item-name mode (often r9=-1 or r9=1).
        Mode -1 is used by Name the, object movement, Climb/Climb down, ingest
        container, and the quantity popup. Inventory detail uses mode 1.
UNIT := complete unit designation, Steam helper 0x132e430, using each caller's
        options. It can contain a generated personal name and RAW caste names.
TALK_TARGET := simpler unit designation from helper 0x1331500, or a historical
               figure's identity/name via helper 0xa946e0. Not a terrain field.
BUILDING := complete building virtual name, slot +0x188 in these constructors;
            failed lookup falls back to finite "building".
TILE := complete native terrain description, Steam helper 0xe7d330. Its tile,
        material, vegetation and fluid grammar is an existing semantic source;
        the final display fragment, or only a word inside it, is not the field.
MAT := material field reconstructed inside Fill/ingest/suck constructors:
       optional historical-figure possessive, RAW NAME_PREFIX, STATE_ADJ and
       STATE_NAME. Fill/ingest add each eligible type-3 contaminant STATE_ADJ
       (amount >=100, phase !=2, material differs from target), then target type
       6 adds independent "stagnant " and "salt " from designation bits30/31.
       Invalid material emits "unknown material". The actual words are RAW
       vocabulary and generated names, not an additional finite UI sentence.
DEPOSIT := Steam helper 0x657f90, classic 0x6559b0; its finite quantity prefixes
           are specks/dusting/spatter/smear/coating/covering + " of ", followed
           by material grammar including identity possessive and RAW prefixes.
BP := entire RAW body-part singular/plural, fallback "body part"/"body parts".
VERMIN := RAW singular creature/caste name from the vermin event.
TREE := RAW plant tree name, fallback "tree".
NAME_LIST := non-player conversation participants from conversation+0x48..50;
             each has unit id or HF id, joined by ", " and final " and ".
             Unresolvable participant ids are skipped. This is a typed list of
             whole TALK_TARGET fields, not one opaque item or terrain field.
N := native decimal integer, helper 0x52c130.

ORDINARY CAPTION SLOT +0x8
0x72250  adventure_optionst: empty method; no fixed prose.
0x6b7080 Continue shouting | Continue conversation with NAME_LIST
         conversation+0x16c bit1 selects shouting; otherwise participant list.
0x6b7320 View yourself | View TALK_TARGET | View the Void
         obj+0x10 equals player id selects yourself; missing unit/HF/name emits
         inline "the Void". Failed HF name is not a fabricated personal name.
0x6b75a0 Start new conversation with TALK_TARGET | Start new conversation with the Void
0x6b7990 Shout out to everybody
0x6b79b0 Assume an identity
0x7e12e0 Gain possession
0x7e1320 Pull it out
0x7e1340 Cease nocking
0x7e13d0 Read
0x7e13f0 Roll
0x7e1410 Roll all
0x834d50 Nock in [ITEM] | Load into [ITEM]
         obj+0x10 item type0x18 and subtype+0x1cc==0 selects Nock in; all other
         cases Load into. Item missing retains only prefix, with no direction.
0x835260 Fill ITEM from ITEM [LOC]
0x835460 Fill ITEM with MAT [LOC]
0x835d50 Name the ITEM
0x835e40 Heat ITEM [HEAT_SOURCE] [LOC]
         HEAT_SOURCE := near magma | near lava | near burning trunk |
         near burning branches | near burning twigs | near burning cap |
         near fire | near campfire. Includes its initial space.
         Magma/lava source is liquid-dependent; remaining source comes from
         tile enum switch RVA0x836074. No matching source omits this suffix.
         Direction is independent; neither source nor direction is compulsory.
0x837ea0 Put on UNIT [LOC]
0x837ff0 Put in BUILDING [LOC] | Put on BUILDING [LOC] | Set on BUILDING [LOC]
0x8381a0 Put in ITEM [LOC]
0x8382f0 Suck UNIT's MAT
0x8387d0 Eat ITEM from ITEM [LOC] | Drink ITEM from ITEM [LOC]
         obj+0x28 contains consumed item; obj+0x20 is container. Consumed
         item's virtual+0x2b0 nonzero selects Drink, otherwise Eat.
0x8389f0 Eat MAT [LOC] | Drink MAT [LOC]
0x8392a0 DEPOSIT (BP)
0x839850 Eat DEPOSIT (BP) | Drink DEPOSIT (BP)
0x839ca0 Eat DEPOSIT (ITEM) | Drink DEPOSIT (ITEM)
         phase1 or phase0/type73 selects Drink, other phases Eat. Null deposits
         or absent owning unit/item produce no text, not a fallback verb.
0x839e40 A VERMIN (DIR)
         Native origin sentinel suppresses VERMIN as well as LOC, leaving
         literal "A ". Invalid RAW with known origin produces "A  (DIR)".
0x83a0e0 Ignite TILE (DIR) | Ignite
         Origin sentinel skips both prepared TILE append and LOC. There is
         no native Ignite TILE form without LOC in this constructor.
0x83a330 Make Campfire [LOC]
0x83a3d0 Fell TREE [LOC]
0x83fe00 Attack error | Attack UNIT [LOC] | Attack creature [LOC] | Attack creatures [LOC]
         Empty target vector is Attack error; missing one target is creature;
         multiple targets use creatures. UNIT comes from actual one-target id.
0x840030 Combat error | Combat UNIT [LOC] | Combat creature [LOC]
         Target id -1 is Combat error; nonnegative missing id is creature.
0x840220 Push ITEM [to DIR] | Push item [to DIR]
0x8403e0 Ride ITEM [, push off toward DIR] | Ride item [, push off toward DIR]
0x8405a0 Guide ITEM [to DIR] | Guide item [to DIR]
         The optional direction clause is entirely omitted at origin sentinel;
         item id lookup failure is finite "item" in all three constructors.
0x840760 Raise BUILDING bucket [LOC]
0x840940 Lower BUILDING bucket [LOC]
0x840b20 Pull BUILDING [LOC]
0x840cf0 Break in BUILDING [LOC]
0x840ec0 Pick BUILDING lock [LOC] (shared door/hatch lock caption)
0x8410a0 Bash down BUILDING [LOC]
0x841270 Topple BUILDING [LOC]
0x841440 Move to TILE [MOVE_LOC] | Move to UNIT [MOVE_LOC] |
         Charge TILE [MOVE_LOC] | Charge UNIT [MOVE_LOC]
         obj+0x24 bit0 selects Charge and may append visible neutral unit names
         found at the target tile; if no unit appended the target is TILE.
0x841900 Climb to TILE [CLIMB_LOC]
0x841bf0 Hold TILE [HOLD_LOC] | Hang from TILE [HOLD_LOC]
0x841f00 Mount UNIT [LOC]
0x842050 Dismount to TILE [LOC]
0x8421b0 Release hold on TILE
0x8422b0 Climb [ITEM] [MOVE_LOC]
         Missing target item retains bare Climb. Target presence and location
         presence are separate branches. No holding/from clause here.
0x8425b0 Claim UNIT [LOC] as pet
0x842710 Lead UNIT [LOC]
0x842860 Stop leading UNIT
0x842940 Climb down [from ITEM]
         Item id is current player+0x4d4; failure retains Climb down.
0x842ab0 Path to here [ (no climbing/jumping)] [LEVEL_CLAUSE] |
         Go below hatch [ (no climbing/jumping)] [LEVEL_CLAUSE]
         LEVEL_CLAUSE := " (" N " level" ["s"] (" up)" | " down)").
         obj+0x23 selects hatch; obj+0x22==0 adds restriction; differing
         obj+0x14 versus obj+0x20 z adds positive absolute depth, s if depth>1,
         up if obj+0x14>obj+0x20, otherwise down. No zero-level clause.
0x8932c0 Get ITEM from UNIT [LOC]
0x8935f0 Get ITEM [LOC] (shared environment/ground-item constructor)
0x893870 Get ITEM from BUILDING [LOC]
0x893bb0 Get ITEM from ITEM [LOC] (shared container/building-contents constructor)
0x893ef0 Pick ITEM [LOC] | Pull ITEM [LOC]
         Native item type0x5b selects Pull; other types Pick.
0x894180 ITEM (shared inventory/view/drop/throw/wear/remove/put/eat/interact +8)
0x894240 engraving
0x8a46d0 Jump to the DIR | DIR
         obj+0x20==0 omits only action prefix, retains whole DIR, no level count.
0x8a4890 Quickly shoot UNIT | Aim carefully and shoot UNIT
         obj+0x38 chooses careful. Missing unit id obj+0x24 emits no caption.
         After unit append the method returns: no direction/range/weapon text.
0x8a5540 Shoot TILE | TILE
         obj+0x20==0 omits prefix; whole terrain description remains.
0x8a5e70 Quickly throw at UNIT | Aim carefully and throw at UNIT
         obj+0x30 chooses careful. Same missing-id/terminal-append behavior.
0x8a64d0 Throw at TILE | TILE

DETAIL CAPTION SLOT +0x10
0x7e1230 Empty inherited detail caption for ordinary types.
0x894260 View engraving
0x894280 View ITEM
0x894370 Drop ITEM
0x894460 Throw ITEM
0x894550 Wear ITEM
0x894640 Remove ITEM
0x894730 Put or place ITEM
0x894820 Eat ITEM | Drink ITEM (item virtual+0x2b0; no location)

CHOOSER RENDERER AND DISPLAY PATHS
Steam RVA0x884460..0x885768; classic RVA0x881ce0..0x882fe8.
Steam title jump table0x885748 categories:
0/3/5/6/7: What do you want to do?
1/2: Where would you like to move?
4: Who or what would you like to shoot? OR
   At whom or what would you like to throw? (global0x18a8a58 flag).
No additional dynamic heading exists for categories3/6/7 in this renderer.
Category3/6 has anchored inventory-relative placement (state+0x10/+0x14),
other categories use screen placement; this changes geometry, not vocabulary.
All ordinary categories use option virtual+8; categories3/6/7 use virtual+16.

Every option row is 3 native tiles tall. Row loop top starts header-top+2 and
advances by3; key and caption use y=top+1. Key x=frame-left+8, caption
x=frame-left+10, independent of whether the row has an item image. With image,
adad70 draws from frame-left+1/top, parameters2,2,5,3,0. Background row fill is
also3 tall. The translation capture's half-font surfaces are another layer;
they must retain this original whole row association instead of demanding a
single arbitrary picture-grid y. Native key label is option index offset+0x52.

At0x885521..0x885528 the option virtual+0x118 is invoked before caption.
75/77 types inherit empty leaf0x72250; only shoot/throw-creature use0x8a54d0,
which resolves the target unit and tail-jumps0x7e4860 to draw its symbol.
It does not change the caption font or produce caption text.

Caption construction precedes native truncation0x885589..0x885615. Native
length is compared with frame width, resized to right-(left+1)-13, and if that
length>3 the final3bytes become literal dots. Rendering is ad9960 at0x885628.
The truncated field in a picture/screen is not the source sentence. Read the
owning native option and selected caption slot to recover its complete source.

Quantity popup: state+0x38!=0 selects a separate early-return renderer path.
Selected option index is state+0x3c; option virtual+0x90 yields ITEM. Complete
item name is c65450 mode-1. Second line is exactly:
  Pick up how many? (0-N)
Maximum N is state+0x40, decimal append0x52c130 at0x884796. Input display
copies state+0x50 if input-active state+0x48, else formats current state+0x44;
blinking underscore is finite "_". Buttons: Okay, Cancel. Ordinary chooser
has Cancel. Neither popup nor action list requests an isolated verb synonym.

EXTRACTION BOUNDARIES
PE unwind intervals define non-leaf ranges. Methods absent from unwind data
end at first return or external unconditional tail jump, so adjacent Read/
Roll/Roll all and Shout/Assume-identity bodies are not assigned to one owner.
Literal TSV records ASCII data operands and printable immediate fragments.
operand_role distinguishes separators, finite text/substrings, inline short
string fragments and numeric std::string layout vectors. Printable bytes such
as "$" in a length/capacity vector are numeric metadata; they are not labels.
Substrings from compiler block-copy loads are operands, not separate runtime
templates. The division-by3 magic 0x55555556 is not inventoried as ASCII.
Complete sentences and typed clauses are the productions above.
